tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground: board, header, status bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, reader page, editor, inputs, menus and modals.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for edgeless buttons, crumbs, menu rows and card actions, on bg or surface (light: 1.11:1 on bg, 1.22:1 on surface; dark: 1.24:1 on bg, 1.13:1 on surface). Fades in over motion-hover.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code, key caps, neutral label pills, the empty-column well, editor gutter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers only: header and status bar rules, modal head and foot rules, the sheet's rules, a modal frame's edge. Decorative, never the edge of a control or a card.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Card edges at rest; hairline of secondary buttons in modal feet and dialogs. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Only edges that identify a control: text fields, checkboxes, radios; plus a card or ghost tile under the pointer. 3.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). Text buttons, labels and key caps have no line-strong edge.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb while scrolling. Hidden at rest: no thumb until the pane scrolls or the pointer reaches its edge. Light 1.75:1 on surface, dark 3.9:1.

tokens.name: scrollbar-active
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb under the pointer (8pt). Light 2.4:1 on surface; dark matches ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-hover, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, paths, counts, dates, word counts, the status bar, modal context. At least 6.4:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, separators, empty-state text, menu key caps. At least 4.5:1 on all surfaces; never smaller than 11px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Blue means selected, focused or a link, nothing else: selected card, focus ring, links, active filter, dragging scrollbar. Not a button fill (see primary).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected card fill, text selection, active crumb.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (checked checkbox, and the primary button if primary is switched back to accent).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one filled button per screen (New issue, Save, Add to Todo). An ink fill, so blue stays for selection and focus. Alternative kept for comparison: set to {accent} with on-primary {on-accent}.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary under the pointer.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring on every focusable element.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Soft 3px glow around a focused text field, textarea, composer or editor, outside its single focus-coloured border. Never a second ring.

tokens.name: status-todo
tokens.usage: Todo column icon: an empty circle. Always shown with the word Todo.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Ready column icon: a dotted circle. Refined issues queued for an agent.

tokens.name: status-doing
tokens.usage: Doing column icon: a half-filled circle; Unsaved pill in the status bar.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done column icon: a filled circle with a check; Saved pill; Pass verdict in a review.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Violet. The AI split button (Ask, Update, Review, Refine) and the Challenge verdict. Reserved: nothing else uses this hue. Kept clearly apart from the blue accent and from danger red.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Review panel header fill and the pending-review card flag.

tokens.name: on-review
tokens.usage: Text on a review fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Write failures, conflicting file on disk, Block verdict, and Delete inside the … menu and the ConfirmDialog. Never at rest in a header.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Delete drop zone when a card is over it. danger text reads 5.7:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on the danger-filled Delete button in the ConfirmDialog.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the board behind a modal confirmation.

tokens.name: label-red
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill; bug by default. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

tokens.name: label-orange
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

tokens.name: label-ochre
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

tokens.name: label-green
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

tokens.name: label-teal
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

tokens.name: label-pink
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

tokens.name: label-grey
tokens.usage: Label dot (6pt) inside a neutral pill; the fallback. Text colour of a loud (tinted) pill, at least 4.5:1 on its tint. No blue (selection) and no violet (review) in this set.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Project name in the header, modal titles.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, card titles (at 500).

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.sample: AI assist to refine an issue
styles.usage: Card title, column titles (title case), current crumb, button labels at 12px.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.sample: Challenge an issue before anyone picks it up

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (Not written yet). Column titles use ui-strong in title case; ui-label is the uppercase alternative.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Inter, ink-muted: paths, file names, counts, dates, word counts, the status bar, modal context (in todo/, named on save, Saved for this session).

styles.name: read-h1
styles.sample: AI assist to refine an issue

styles.name: read-h2
styles.usage: ## headings in the reader. 24pt above, 6pt below.

styles.name: read-h3
styles.usage: ### headings and deeper in the reader. 16pt above, 4pt below.

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: Challenge an issue before anyone picks it up, so a human or an AI can implement it without guessing.
styles.usage: Rendered markdown paragraphs and lists, in a read-measure (560pt, about 75 characters) column.

styles.name: edit-body
styles.usage: The plain-text editor, code blocks and diffs.

styles.name: meta-mono
styles.usage: JetBrains Mono: key caps only (Kbd, key hints in buttons, menus and tooltips).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label nudges, kbd padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between labels, icon to text in pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, between a card's rows (labels, title, summary), between header controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding, review row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Window gutter, column gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Reader page vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Reader page horizontal padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, kbd, crumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, reader page, editor, review panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 18px-tall pills (Saved, Unsaved, verdicts).

size.note: Fixed control heights, in points. Compact but at least 22pt to stay clickable on a trackpad.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter input, checkbox row.

tokens.name: status-icon
tokens.usage: Column status icon: 14pt box, 1.5pt stroke, in the status colour.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Header bar. The traffic lights sit on its centre line (titlebar-light-y).

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom status bar.

tokens.name: column-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest column before the board scrolls sideways: four columns fit the 880pt minimum window.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Widest column; extra width stays empty on the right.

tokens.name: reader-max
tokens.usage: Reader and editor sheet width: read-measure plus 32pt padding each side.

tokens.name: read-measure
tokens.usage: Text column of the reader at read-body: about 75 characters per line (measured 70 to 79 on prose).

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb width at rest and while scrolling. Overlay: takes no layout width.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb width under the pointer and while dragging.

tokens.name: scroll-hit
tokens.usage: Pointer strip along the pane's edge, wider than the thumb so a trackpad finds it. The pointer entering it reveals a hidden thumb.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-min
tokens.usage: Shortest thumb on a very long page, the same as control-h.

tokens.name: modal-s
tokens.usage: Modal S: one question, one action (ConfirmDialog).

tokens.name: modal-m
tokens.usage: Modal M: forms and settings (Settings, GroupsDialog).

tokens.name: modal-l
tokens.usage: Modal L: one document, a 720pt sheet with 20pt each side.

tokens.name: modal-xl
tokens.usage: Modal XL maximum width; otherwise the window minus modal-inset each side (NewIssueModal, RefinePanel).

tokens.name: modal-xl-h
tokens.usage: Modal XL maximum height; XL is always this tall or the window minus the inset, so nothing jumps while content streams in.

tokens.name: modal-inset
tokens.usage: Gap kept between the window and a modal: 16 at the sides and bottom under 720pt of window width, but always 32 at the top, below the traffic lights (titlebar-h).

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Top strip the traffic lights occupy (they span 14 to 26 once centred on the bar). No modal frame enters it; the top modal inset never drops below modal-inset.

tokens.name: titlebar-lead
tokens.usage: Leading width the traffic lights take in the header bar (three 12pt lights, centres 20, 40, 60). Nothing is drawn or clickable there; the project name or the Board button starts after it.

tokens.name: titlebar-light-y
tokens.usage: Centre line of the traffic lights, from the window's top: bar-h / 2. The header's controls and crumbs centre on the same line.

tokens.name: titlebar-light-x
tokens.usage: Centre of the close button from the window's left edge; the next two follow every 20pt.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Review panel, menus and a dragged card. Cards stay flat; modals use shadow-modal.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals only (S to XL), above the scrim. Stronger than shadow-popover because a modal floats over everything.

tokens.name: label-tint
tokens.usage: A loud label pill's fill in the light theme: its label colour at this opacity over surface. Only for labels marked Stand out (bug by default).

tokens.name: label-tint-dark
tokens.usage: The same fill in the dark theme, where a 10% tint is too faint on surface. bundle.css swaps it in under [data-theme="dark"].

motion.note: Durations; with reduced motion every one is 0 (state changes in one frame).

tokens.name: motion-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fills fading in (buttons, crumbs, menu rows, card actions, card edge). Fading out is instant. Keyboard selection never animates.

tokens.name: motion-hint
tokens.usage: Key hints sliding out beside their control when ⌘ is held, and back.

tokens.name: hint-hold
tokens.usage: How long ⌘ alone must be held before key hints show. Any other key, or letting go, cancels and hides them.

tokens.name: scroll-linger
tokens.usage: How long a scrollbar stays after the last scroll movement, or after the pointer leaves the edge strip.

tokens.name: scroll-fade
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb fading in and out.
